note: e2e fixture for #870: the shipped ksp_system Kerbol and Moho verbatim, with ONE number changed -- rotating.rot_ang_speed 0 on Moho (shipped: 5.1927151299004845e-06, a ~33.5 h day). Why a file at all, when the state is reachable in shipped content: 38 of solar_system.json's bodies carry no rotating block at all and system.cpp:2199 gives them rot_ang_speed 0, and Kerbin's own polar pad reaches the same state through |omega x r| -> 0 -- but no shipped pad sits on a non-turning body, so a case that wants the whole row stock has to move a pad body into the state instead. Parked on Moho's pad here the conic speed is 3..7e-05 m/s of contact-solver residue, so the prograde the HUD printed was a heading made of that residue -- and exactly NaN once the vector lands on zero, which is the shape [orbinfo]'s prg=-nan rows in #870 came from. Moho keeps its shipped radius, mass, orbit, tilt and no atmosphere, and authors no sea_level; the pad is the shipped moho_pad from res/data/ksp_launch_sites.json copied inline. Pinned by e2e/cases/render/870-parked-on-a-world-that-does-not-turn.txt; the shipped-content half is e2e/cases/render/870-prg-dash-on-a-polar-pad.txt.
